meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写实现代码,让每次改动都有测试兜底
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果担心改坏别处代码,想先立好测试再动手写实现
copy.tagline_en: Write failing tests first, then make them pass before shipping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want tests guarding every change before you write code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在写功能或修 bug 的代码之前，先写一个测试并运行、确认它真的失败，再写刚好让测试通过的最小代码，最后在测试保持通过的前提下清理代码。
howto.when: 当你要求实现功能、修 bug 或重构时，它会先写测试再写代码；一次性原型、生成的代码、配置文件等例外会先征求你的同意。

say.text: 帮我加一个邮箱格式校验功能
say.note: 它会先写一个会失败的测试，再写代码

say.text: 空邮箱被通过这个 bug 帮我修一下
say.note: 先写复现 bug 的失败测试，再修代码

say.text: 把这段校验逻辑重构一下
say.note: 重构前会先确认测试全绿

howto.what_en: After install, before writing any feature or bugfix code, Claude writes one test, runs it to confirm it fails, then writes the minimal code to make it pass, and only then cleans up while tests stay green.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement a feature, fix a bug, or refactor. Throwaway prototypes, generated code, and config files are exceptions it will ask you about first.

say_en.text: Add email format validation to this form
say_en.note: It writes a failing test first, then the code

say_en.text: Fix the bug where empty emails are accepted
say_en.note: It writes a failing test that reproduces it first
It confirms the tests are green before refactoring
